title: Module 1 Itinerary Output
description: Structured itinerary emitted by Module 1 (Itinerary Generator) inside <itinerary_json> tags. Fields are exactly the 'Output format (strict, nothing else emitted)' list in Architecture.md Stage 3 — days, transit_segments, missing_info. Module 1 never judges feasibility or cost, so this schema carries no verdict, price, or feasibility field.

days.description: One entry per day of the trip.

ward_or_city.description: Ward or city, used by the non-LLM Constraint Validator for the geographic plausibility check.

is_dining.description: true when this stop is a meal. Drives the Constraint Validator's dietary hard-filter (success criterion 2). REQUIRED on every stop: a missing value is a schema error the model must fix, not a silently-unverified dietary check downstream (CLAUDE.md locked decision, Architecture.md Stage 3).

transit_segments.description: Input to Module 2's calculator. service_type is deliberately absent: Architecture.md Stage 3 puts service_type on Ulfa's fare table, and the calculator resolves a segment to its fare row by station pair.

mode.description: e.g. shinkansen, local_train, subway, bus, walk. Non-fare modes must be filtered out before the segment list reaches the calculator.

missing_info.description: Fields the model could not fill from the user's input. Architecture.md Stage 3: never guess a field, list it here instead. An empty array means nothing was missing.
